designAdmission.scope: completed catalog owner/consumer response correction followed only by existing backend-unit, managed reset, r5-full seed and catalog L2 runners

businessInvariant: Platform administrators never receive workspace catalog capability.

Operations writes retain authenticated operations session, explicit selected data node, live EDIT_STORE_CATALOG or EDIT_HEAD_COMPANY_CATALOG capability, server-minted grant, owner recheck and REQUIRED transaction.
Temporary external-order catalog state remains the existing normal owner-HTTP lifecycle; no terminal fixture, SQL, RM1/R5 runtime, reset, seed, endpoint or capability is introduced.
technicalScope: Correct category-delete response to its existing canonical contract and choose/prove its truthful replay behavior without globally moving receipt lookup ahead of owner recheck.
Correct temporary-promotion preflight to its existing single-envelope contract and change its sole operations-admin consumer accordingly.

Keep the existing category-owner and operations-admin consumer regressions current; canonical OpenAPI and generated wires remain read-only and must remain byte-identical. The canonical P1 generator may correct the API scenario/fixture semantics that falsely required an impossible dangling reference through a normal public local-copy journey: the generated fixture catalog and API scenario catalog may instead bind CI-API-020-01 to normal same-scope owner-HTTP copy/readback, while the existing owner integration proof retains controlled malformed-mapping rejection. The existing P4 pre-L2 control gate may replace stale hard-coded aggregate polarity/expectation counts with exact-set verification against the generator-owned caseBindingSets; it must continue to reject any case-set drift. The existing P2 static gate may check the typed copy-source policy and typed catalog preflight boundary, while rejecting retired request-derived source scope and operation-name branching. The existing joint L2 fixture may retain a redacted nonterminating bootstrap-failure artifact diagnostic so a malformed or absent artifact cannot conceal the true failed command. Run only the existing catalog backend-unit, managed reset, r5-full seed and catalog L2 entries. The existing backend-unit runner may receive the necessary Testcontainers execution-plane classification repair; the existing remote Testcontainers runner may update only its pinned local Gradle distribution path from the absent 9.6.1 install to the present 9.7.0 install. The existing catalog and inventory owner-scope tests may remove their invalid Mockito mock of the sealed WorkspaceExecutionContext; the only concrete context is deliberately mintable by workspace-IAM, so the invalid opaque-grant construction is not an executable unit fixture. The existing image-bind evidence input list may replace the retired app-layout asset-lifecycle test path with its current module-owned global asset-reference integration proof. The existing managed start may receive only the finite Bean proxy correction: remove finality from the eight @Service classes in audit-read, organization, workspace and workspace-iam whose public read method is @Transactional(readOnly = true), preserving their closed query variants and owner calls. The existing seed may receive the exact nested-read-budget correction at WorkspaceTaskReadService.sessionEntry: delegate to the authentication owner, which already attributes CONTEXT_WORKSPACE_IAM, without additionally wrapping it as PRIMARY_QUERY. The existing L2 fixture consumer may update only its expected SHA-256 to the current canonical catalog-inventory-fixture-catalog.json bytes. The existing catalog API runner may replace invalid dangling-reference fixtures with normal owner-HTTP state and assert the legitimate owner result at its actual boundary. Runtime first-failure repair may update only the exact closed owner/coordinator/edge paths needed to: accept the OpenAPI-required dataNodeRef transport field in inventory action bodies; preserve full cross-owner opaque mapping plans while each owner consumes only its own vocabulary; return preflight compatibility readback before execute-time structural rejection; derive and verify a catalog-only digest before combined owner execution; forward the nonsecret catalog fault admission only to the local non-production business server; and map a valid authenticated catalog operation's forbidden scope to the existing typed SCOPE_FORBIDDEN problem without changing unauthenticated/common-denial behavior. All proofs remain in existing module test tasks and existing runner tests; no test target or runtime topology may be added or changed.
